thresholds.trendRule: Reject excessive median growth or positive regression slope above threshold with three consecutive significantly increasing windows; five-minute medians smooth GC spikes. GPU working set reported separately, never GPU VRAM.

clock: real wall clock, no virtual time
cpuMeaning: percentCPUUsage is the raw Electron process metric over its sampling interval; not system energy consumption or battery usage.
memoryMeaning: Electron app.getAppMetrics memory.workingSetSize in KiB (OS working set, not a strict cross-platform RSS measure). Renderer V8 usedJSHeapSize in bytes. GPU-process working set is NOT GPU VRAM.
